'''Special Agent''' was a rank used by several organizations.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], it was used by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] and ranked above [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] and below [[Bureau Chief]].

It was also a position in the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]], held by [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]].

The [[Special forces/Legends|Special forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], also known as [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]], used the rank to designate agents assigned to specific missions.

Special Agent was a catch-all term for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives that filled unique posts. [[Greg Somax]], an agent embedded at the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Imperial Naval Academy]], was classified as a Special Agent.<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> They were also referred to as Special Operatives.<ref name="AJ11">{{JournalCite|11|Cracken's Rebel Operatives (article)}}</ref>

[[Ben Skywalker]] held it while working for the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]].
